thread:
maria-support: FYI customer reported embedding endpoint returning dimension mismatch errors intermittently and huge tail latency spikes after noon deploy. They send batches and sometimes get 0-length vectors or 1536 vs 1024 mismatch.

maria-support: Repro steps attached (curl + payload), they've set max_batch_size=64 on dedicated pool, dynamic_batching=true.

maria-support: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model": "open-embed-small-1024", "input": ["short text"]}'
```

maria-support: customer logs show: "BatchDimensionsMismatch: expected dim=1024 got=1536" and occasional "processed=0 vectors" lines.

jeff-eng: can you paste the raw request headers and full payload size distribution? suspect mixed-model routing or a stale model variant.

maria-support: sent anonymized traces (link) + sample payload sizes: mostly 1-8 items, a few ~200-item bursts from their batched client.

anya-ml: If they're on a model family with multiple size variants we sometimes route to the 1536 variant when capacity forces fallback. Are they pinning a model version?

maria-support: nope, they're using model alias "open-embed-small-1024:latest" (no pin).

ben-eng-infra: quick check: which pool/route is this hitting? any dedicated shard mixing?

maria-support: dedicated-pool customer-42-region-us-east; they requested reserved capacity but recently added a burst policy.

ben-eng-infra: hunch: dynamic batching + multi-variant fallback could mix tensors if fallback switches mid-batch. Need request trace to see per-request model_id.

jeff-eng: also see tail latency spike graphs around 12:04 -> 12:12 UTC, queueing increased 10x. Could be huge single-coalesced batch created by dynamic coalescer. Try lowering max_batch_size to 32 as a test.

maria-support: asked customer to set max_batch_size=32 and to pin model to exact version. awaiting their update.

deploy-bot: [system] config change applied to pool dedicated-pool customer-42-region-us-east: max_batch_size=32 by ops (maria-support).

maria-support: customer reports immediate reduction in dimension mismatch but still seeing tail latency occasionally (~2–3s vs 8–10s earlier).

anya-ml: good sign. Next step: disable dynamic_batching for that route for 1 hour to see if coalescing is root cause. Dynamic batching can coalesce multi-variant requests when fallback occurs.

ben-eng-infra: also check kernel selection logs — if runtime switches quantized model variant during a batch, output dims can differ. I'll pull kernel/runtime logs for the time window.

oncall-rt: tagging for visibility @oncall-rt. marking Sev3 until we confirm no data loss.

oncall-rt: grabbed runtime logs, seeing a sequence where 3 requests in same coalesced batch had model_id: open-embed-small-1024@v3, open-embed-small-1536@v1, open-embed-small-1024@v3. That exactly explains the dim mismatch.

oncall-rt: root cause appears to be routing fallback to larger variant when capacity scarce; dynamic coalescer doesn't currently enforce homogenous-model constraint.

jeff-eng: mitigation: 1) enforce model-homogenous coalescing 2) respect pinned model_id when provided 3) temporary: disallow fallback to larger variant for this customer's pool.

maria-support: relayed to customer: asking if they'd accept pinning to v3 for now; customer prefers pin over changing client.

maria-support: customer pinned to open-embed-small-1024@v3 and we disabled fallback for their pool. monitoring.

ben-eng-infra: opened infra ticket INF-2247 to add a coalescer check.

jeff-eng: will follow up with a small runtime patch to reject mixed-model batches (safety check) and add metric for mixed_model_coalesces.

anya-ml: ML note: add a validation in model catalog to surface dimension mismatches in route configs (warn on alias with multi-variant families).

maria-support: customer reports no further dim errors after pin; tail latency dropped to ~1.2s median, 95p ~2.7s. They are happy. :tada:

maria-support: closing from support side, keeping infra/eng owners on the infra ticket. Thanks all. :heart:
